## Methodology

- [ ] No confidence label is raised beyond what the evidence in this PR warrants.
- [ ] No failure condition is removed or weakened.
- [ ] Interpretation is not presented as derivation.
- [ ] New claims have `traceability/claims/` entries.

## Conformance

- [ ] The branch is up to date with `main`, and its content has been read against the current hard core, the charter with its amendment records, and the latest rulings record.
- [ ] Where this work predates a change to those texts, it is conformed or carries a reconciliation note.

## Branch hygiene

- [ ] The branch name follows `<type>/<topic>` (types and rules: `0-program-methods/github-workflow.md`, Branch discipline).
- [ ] This PR was opened at the branch's first push.
- [ ] If the branch will be idle for more than 14 days, the PR carries a line `Renewed until: YYYY-MM-DD; reason: ...` at most 30 days ahead, or it is closed with an `archive/<branch>` tag.
